image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a stack of three bagels on a reddish surface. The top two bagels are whole, featuring a golden-brown crust topped with poppy seeds and possibly sesame seeds. They exhibit a glossy sheen consistent with boiling before baking. The bottom item appears to be a sliced bagel or a different baked good, heavily textured with dark char marks and white salt crystals, sitting flat rather than showing the typical ring profile clearly due to the angle and cropping.
